# Technical State Audit

Site:
Scope:
Date:
Owner:

| URL | Priority/value | Intended index state | Accessible | Status | Rendered | Robots | Index directive | Declared canonical | Selected canonical | Indexed | Sitemap | In-links | Depth | Field LCP | Field INP | Field CLS | Structured data | Decision |
|---|---:|---|---|---:|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|---|

## Value-ranked issues

| Issue | Affected priority URLs | Affected demand/value | Probability of impact | Effort | Risk | Priority | LAKA level |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|

## Decision logic

```text
IF issue blocks measurement or eligibility
THEN P0.

ELSE IF issue affects a high-value canonical cohort
THEN score by incremental value / effort.

ELSE monitor or batch with maintenance.
```
